visual_language.medium: Sacred technical plate: soft graphite and silverpoint drafting over charcoal-gray rag paper, with translucent mineral-pigment/glaze color behaving like emitted light through a hand-built geometric diagram.
visual_language.surface: Matte graphite tooth, rubbed construction lines, faint cube grids, compass marks, pressure-darkened pencil, translucent color overlap, and occasional silver lunar sheen remain materially visible.
visual_language.mark_making: Precise diagram line and heraldic silhouette are crossed with hand-drawn construction, stipple, measured hatching, geometric registration, and luminous color fields. Truth/Love/Courage may appear as blue/green/red channels or structural directions, never as decorative RGB UI chrome.
visual_language.signature_accent: The three Principle channels—Truth blue, Love green, Courage red—combine additively into the eight virtue colors. Small channel traces, cube-corner geometry, or registration marks may reveal the lattice beneath an image without turning every card into the same diagram.
visual_language.finish: A tactile occult instrument from Britannia: part heraldic atlas, part color-theory plate, part shrine diagram. Abstract enough to expose the 3-bit lattice, concrete enough that each octave still depicts its place/person/word/object/site.
avoid: mere hue-swapped copies with identical composition
rainbow gradients unrelated to the three Principle channels
pixel-art nostalgia as the primary visual language
flattening arithmetic factorization and bit-lattice decomposition into the same structure
